1.mascotDialogue: The queue na wetin dey make this breadth-first, not depth-first! Whatever dem discover first, na e dem go explore first — FIFO order, doing the level-by-level spreading for you.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 12 na the guard wey dey keep BFS from looping forever — mark visited the moment you enqueue, not the moment you dequeue, or you go dey enqueue the same node again and again!

3.mascotDialogue: 1 and 2, both distance-one from the start — so dem visited before 3, wey na distance-two from either! Na the level-order guarantee, working exactly as e promise.

4.mascotDialogue: One missing line, and BFS whole promise — visit every node exactly once — go quietly stop holding for any graph wey no be simple tree.
